title: A federal court in Neuquén sentences four military servicemen to prison terms ranging between 3 and 15 years for the 1994 murder of Omar Carrasco.
text: The murder of Omar Octavio Carrasco, a 20-year-old conscript in the Argentine Army, occurred in the early days of March 1994. Initially reported as a deserter by military authorities, Carrasco's body was found some 700 metres (2,300 ft) from his assigned barracks in Zapala, Neuquén Province.

title: The sports newspaper Olé is launched by the Clarín Group in Buenos Aires.
text: Olé is an Argentine national daily sports newspaper published in Buenos Aires. The publication was launched on May 23, 1996, by the Clarín Group.

title: The airline Baires Fly is established.
text: Baires Fly S.A. is an airline based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. It was established on May 30, 1996, and operates passenger and cargo charter services.

text: William Jefferson Clinton is an American retired politician and lawyer who served as the 42nd president of the United States from 1993 to 2001. A member of the Democratic Party, he previously served as the attorney general of Arkansas from 1977 to 1979, the governor of Arkansas from 1979 to 1981, and governor again from 1983 to 1992.
